info.name: The Beginner Pirate's Second Training Session

descriptions.notStarted: I've become a bit stronger from the training, but I've still got a long way to go. I should go ask #bKyrin#k for some help!
descriptions.inProgress: Kyrin tells me that I still need more training on the basics and suggests that I hunt down some more monsters. She wants me to hunt down #r26 pigs#k this time... \n\n#o 1210100# #r#a21941##k
descriptions.completed: I've hunted down 26 pigs and reported the results to Kyrin. Hehe, hunting down 26 pigs? It was a total breeze!
